🎃 NEW TACTIC — BABY TRADING CARDS (baseball card, minus the baseball) · 1/3
NETANYAHU. Recognizable-as-hell cartoon baby: silver comb-back, hooded eyes, jowls. Sucking a baby bottle full of gold coins + a US dollar bill instead of milk (the aid pipeline). Schoolhouse Rock cel look, clean ornate card frame, name baked on the banner in clean type (no garble — added in post).

🎃 BABY CARDS · 2/3
THIEL. High domed forehead, receding brown wisp, tight little smile, pale-blue eyes — unmistakable. Perched on a stack of surveillance-server bricks, chess king in one fist, juice box in the other. (Palantir co-founder / the money behind it.)

🎃 BABY CARDS · 3/3
KARP. The Palantir CEO — wild frizzy grey mop, wire glasses, wiry face. Cradling a glowing crystal 'seeing-stone' (a palantír — the company's literal namesake, the all-seeing surveillance orb).

Direction check: this the vibe? I can (a) do a whole set — Abbott, Miriam Adelson, the donors — same card format, (b) add a fake stat-line / set logo to the cards, or (c) push them darker/creepier. Say the word and I'll run the rest.
